You are implementing Task 5: 物料管理页面

## Task Description

Create the item list page and item form dialog.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/items/page.tsx` — item list with search, category filter, table (desktop) + cards (mobile)
- Create: `src/components/item-form-dialog.tsx` — create/edit dialog with tabs for basic info, server parts, and other fields

## BEFORE WRITING ANY CODE

Read these shadcn component files to understand their actual v4 API:
- `src/components/ui/dialog.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/tabs.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/select.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/input.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/textarea.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/table.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/card.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/badge.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/button.tsx`

Also note: `Label` from shadcn may not exist. Use native `<label className="text-sm font-medium">` if needed. The `Input` component may differ from standard shadcn v3.

## Item List Page: `src/app/items/page.tsx`

This is a client component that:
1. Fetches items from `/api/items?q=&categoryId=` 
2. Fetches categories from `/api/categories`
3. Has a search bar (text input with Enter key search)
4. Has a category filter dropdown (Select)
5. Shows items in a Table on desktop (md+), cards on mobile
6. Each row shows: code, name (link to detail), model, category badge, quantity (red if at/below safetyStock), position
7. Click edit button opens the ItemFormDialog
8. "新增物料" button opens ItemFormDialog in create mode

## Item Form Dialog: `src/components/item-form-dialog.tsx`

A Dialog with Tabs for organized fields:

**Tab 1: 基本信息 (basic)**
- code (编号), name (名称) — required
- categoryId (分类 Select), unit (单位 Select with options: 个/米/千克/卷/包/箱/台/张/支/根)
- description (描述), quantity (初始库存 number), safetyStock (安全库存 number)
- position (存放位置), price (参考单价 number), supplier (供应商), model (型号)

**Tab 2: 服务器部件 (server)**
- sn (SN号), manufacturer (厂商)
- warrantyStart (维保起始 date input), warrantyEnd (维保截止 date input)
- nandType (SSD颗粒 Select: SLC/MLC/TLC/QLC, with "不适用" option)
- compatibleProducts (适用产品)

**Tab 3: 其他 (other)**
- description as Textarea for longer notes

Props:
```typescript
interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  item?: Item | null; // null = create mode
  categories: Category[]; // flat list for Select
  onSaved: () => void; // callback to reload list
}
```

## Key Implementation Details

1. **Item interface** — define at top of form dialog:
```typescript
interface ItemFormData {
  id?: string;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  sn?: string;
  model?: string;
  manufacturer?: string;
  categoryId: string;
  unit: string;
  quantity?: number;
  safetyStock?: number;
  position?: string;
  supplier?: string;
  price?: number;
  warrantyStart?: string;
  warrantyEnd?: string;
  nandType?: string;
  compatibleProducts?: string;
}
```

2. **Category list flattening** — the API returns categories with children. On the page, flatten: for each parent, add parent then its children. Show children indented in the Select: `"  └ 硬盘"`.

3. **Quantity color** — if `item.quantity <= item.safetyStock && item.safetyStock > 0`, show quantity in red.

4. **Error handling** — check `res.ok` on all fetch calls. Show `alert()` on errors.

5. **Save logic** — POST to `/api/items` (create) or PUT to `/api/items/${item.id}` (update). On success, close dialog and call `onSaved()`.

6. **Tabs** — use shadcn Tabs component. Read the actual API from the tabs.tsx file.

## After Implementation

```bash
npm run build
```

Fix any TypeScript errors or import issues.

Commit:
```bash
git add -A
git commit -m "feat: add item list page with search and create/edit dialog"
```

## Context

Project: spare parts management system (备品备件管理系统)
- Next.js 16 App Router, Prisma 7, shadcn/ui 4.7, Tailwind v4
- Items API at `/api/items` (GET list + POST create) and `/api/items/[id]` (GET/PUT/DELETE)
- Categories API at `/api/categories` (GET list)
- shadcn components in `src/components/ui/`

Work from: /Users/felix/code/.claude/worktrees/beijian+spare-parts-management/beijian/

Report back with status and any issues.
